visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a light blue shirt stands in front of a shelf stocked with various bottles. A bright neon sign reading 'TAIWAN BAR' is mounted on the red wall above him. He speaks with expressive facial movements and rhythmic hand gestures. (2) The screen displays historical graphics and a black-and-white portrait of a man in vintage attire, Shinpei Goto, labeled as 'Civil Governor.' Icons representing land surveys and population statistics appear. (3) A night shot of the Tokyo Skytree and the surrounding city skyline is shown, followed by a photo of a ruined building with torn curtains. (4) A black-and-white photograph shows a group of men in suits in a formal meeting setting. (5) Modern laboratory footage appears, featuring individuals in white biohazard suits working in a sterile environment labeled 'COVID-19 AFFECTED ZONE.' (6) The host returns, gesturing broadly and pointing at the camera as he concludes his talk in the studio setting.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 一分鐘聊聊歷史人物. [Logo]: TAIWAN BAR. (2) [Subtitle]: 今天來聊聊後藤新平. (3) [Subtitle]: 臺灣吧 10 年前第一支影片就談的人物. (4) [Subtitle]: 大家應該不陌生吧. (5) [Subtitle]: 對他最熟悉的事情就是臺灣走向現代化. (6) [Subtitle]: 算是在最重要歷史人物. (7) [Subtitle]: 擔任當時的民政長官. (8) [Subtitle]: 推動許多現代化的改革. (9) [Subtitle]: 不過他在臺灣其實待不到10年. (10) [Subtitle]: 不只是在臺灣重要. (11) [Subtitle]: 放眼當時整個日本的政壇. (12) [Subtitle]: 擔任非常多重要的職位. (13) [Subtitle]: 你去過東京嗎. (14) [Subtitle]: 東京今天長成現在這個樣子. (15) [Subtitle]: 也跟後藤新平有關. (16) [Subtitle]: 1923年日本發生了非常嚴重的關東大地震. (17) [Subtitle]: 整個東京被夷為平地. (18) [Subtitle]: 派了後藤新平來主持帝都復興院. (19) [Subtitle]: 東京現代化的都市規劃. (20) [Subtitle]: 就在他任內的時候提出了完整的構想. (21) [Subtitle]: 他在來臺灣之前曾經擔任內務省的衛生局局長. (22) [Subtitle]: 建了一個傳染病研究所. (23) [Subtitle]: 有附近的居民開始抗議. (24) [Subtitle]: 害得我也得傳染病怎麼辦. (25) [Subtitle]: 後藤新平就很生氣. (26) [Subtitle]: 不喜歡這種民智未開的狀態. (27) [Subtitle]: 他直接趁一個月黑風高的夜晚. (28) [Subtitle]: 叫他的下屬直接把傳染病研究所招牌塗黑. (29) [Subtitle]: 隔天抗議居民來到現場發現招牌塗黑. (30) [Subtitle]: 太激進了吧. (31) [Subtitle]: 事情就不了了之. (32) [Subtitle]: 解決問題. (33) [Subtitle]: 可以感受到有時候他用的手段有點. (34) [Subtitle]: 日本政府在一些艱難的事情上就會讓他來處理. (35) [Subtitle]: 留言「後藤新平」就告訴你更多相關的故事哦.
